semantic_atoms.claim: Realtime frank_forschung action=neu_anstossen can submit asynchronous research after only local argument validation; explicit-user-request intent is primarily expressed in tool/persona guidance, not a deterministic local HumanIntentDecision bound to the submitted question.

A research submission may consume network/provider/browser resources and transmit user text even when it is not a direct world mutation; it therefore needs an explicit capability/privacy/economic admission class rather than being treated as a read-only observation.

The donor hooks manifest declares broad PreToolUse/PostToolUse routing to stern.py, but repository configuration presence does not prove the exact installed plugin/version, headless claude -p process, ordering, hook firing, or executor consumption on the current host.

The two-step voice task confirmation is a TaskAdmission precursor, while the delegated worker may later issue multiple Write/Edit or other mutations. One valid task confirmation must not become a blanket capability for all downstream effects.

architecture_deltas.delta: Classify a Realtime research launch as ResearchRequestCandidate, bind immutable source utterance/call identity and request digest, then require deterministic HumanIntentDecision before submission when the operation class requires explicit user intent.

After HumanIntentDecision, independently resolve provider/network/privacy/economic capability admission. Human intent to research does not itself authorize an unbounded provider route, spend class or data egress.

Treat hooks.json as declared configuration only. Triggerword-4 runtime acceptance must bind exact installed plugin/config/source identity to a headless delegated call and prove PreToolUse decision -> DENY/nonexecution or ALLOW -> exact invocation dispatch at the real executor boundary.

Keep VoiceIntentEvidence -> TaskAdmission separate from per-effect EffectDecision. A task_admission_id may authorize bounded task creation but each real mutation still consumes its own one-shot typed EffectDecision/CapabilityLease.

contradictions.resolution_rule: Add deterministic HumanIntentDecision and provider/privacy/economic admission before research submission; tool-description compliance is candidate behavior, not authority.
Require exact installed configuration plus source-bound runtime receipt; FILE_EXISTS != LIVE_RUNTIME.
TaskAdmission never substitutes for executor-consumed per-effect EffectDecision.

counterhypotheses: Current host/plugin configuration may already fire a stronger blocking PreToolUse path for every delegated non-Bash mutation; exact source-bound runtime evidence would reduce implementation work but not remove the need for immutable invocation identity.
Research submission may be operationally classified as coordination rather than world effect; even so, data egress and provider/resource use remain explicit capability/privacy/economic dimensions.
triggerword4_acceptance_tests: A model-generated research tool call without matching HumanIntentDecision cannot submit a provider/network request.
A valid HumanIntentDecision cannot silently broaden provider route, privacy scope or spend/economic class.
A confirmed voice task can create one task_admission_id but cannot authorize an unrelated downstream Write/Edit effect.
Headless claude -p runtime receipt binds exact installed hook/config/source identity; DENY proves zero executor dispatch for the exact invocation.
Absence/mismatch of declared hook runtime identity fails closed for any claim that depends on that hook as the enforcement boundary.
next_exact_gate: Recover exact headless claude -p installed hook/settings reachability and trace stern.chatgpt_senden provider/privacy/economic admission, then feed Triggerword-4 deterministic HumanIntentDecision -> ResearchRequestAdmission and TaskAdmission -> per-effect EffectDecision tests.
